Title: Google Tag Manager Integration
Description: Connect your websites using Google Tag Manager
Meta Description: Connect your websites using Google Tag Manager
overview: Connect Superflow with your sites within minutes using Google Tag Manager
steps__1__title: Start by adding your website URL
steps__1__text:
If Google Tag Manager is detected with the site URL you entered, you will see a banner at the top recommending that you install with Google Tag Manager.

Click Start Setup inside the banner to install Superflow with Google Tag Manager.
steps__2__title: Authenticate with your Google Tag Manager account
steps__2__text: You will be asked to authenticate with the email associated with your Google Tag Manager account.
steps__3__title: Choose an Account and Tag Container
steps__3__text: Choose the Google Tag Manager Account and Tag Container that you will be using to install Superflow within.
steps__4__text:
We will now create and publish a tag on your Google Tag Manager Account and Tag Container.

Click on Create and Publish Tag to authorize this.

Title: Monday.com Integration with Superflow
Description: Turn your Superflow comments into Monday.com tasks or subtasks.
Meta Description: Turn your Superflow comments into Monday.com tasks or subtasks.
overview:
The integration of Superflow with Monday.com facilitates the seamless transition of Superflow comments into Monday.com tasks.

This integration is designed to optimize your workflow, minimizing the time and resources required for task management.
steps__1__text:
• Go to your Superflow Integrations tab

  • Click on "Install App" to authorize the Superflow and Monday.com
steps__2__title: Connect to Monday to turn Superflow comments into tasks
steps__2__text: You will be redirected to Monday.com and you can authorize the app
steps__3__text: This is where all the Superflow comments will be exported.
steps__4__title: Connect a Superflow project to an Monday Project or Task
steps__4__text: All Superflow comments will be created as Tasks under the selected Monday Board or you can connect to a specific Monday task to create subtasks

Title: Superflow Installation Guide for Webflow
Meta Description: Give feedback within your webflow sites
overview: Whether you're a designer, developer, or project manager, Superflow will streamline your web design process and communication with your team.
steps__1__text: Begin by navigating to the Webflow marketplace and installing the Superflow application
steps__2__text: After granting the necessary authorizations, select the specific Webflow project you wish to integrate with Superflow
steps__3__text: Proceed to the custom code section within Webflow and insert the provided line of script to ensure proper functionality
steps__4__text: For enhanced workflow, invite your team members. This will allow you to efficiently tag and assign them to specific tasks
steps__5__text: Access your project via the review link. A toolbar will be present at the bottom right corner. Utilize the comment icon to input your inaugural feedback

Title: ClickUp Integration with Superflow
Description: Turn your Superflow comments into ClickUp tasks or subtasks.
Meta Description: Turn your Superflow comments into ClickUp tasks or subtasks.
overview:
The integration of Superflow with ClickUp facilitates the seamless transition of Superflow comments into ClickUp tasks.

This integration is designed to optimize your workflow, minimizing the time and resources required for task management.
steps__1__text:
• Proceed to the integrations page within the Superflow portal.

  • Identify and select the appropriate ClickUp Space. This will be the repository for Superflow comments and associated tasks.
steps__2__title: Associate a Superflow Project with a ClickUp List:
steps__2__text:
• Subsequently, establish a linkage between your Superflow project and a specific ClickUp List.

  • All comments originating from Superflow will be automatically converted into tasks within the chosen ClickUp List.
steps__3__title: Connect to a Specific ClickUp Task (Optional):
steps__3__text:
• For those seeking enhanced specificity, there's the option to connect your Superflow project directly to a task within a ClickUp List.

  • With this setup, all Superflow comments will be manifested as subtasks under the selected ClickUp task.

Title: Slack and Superflow: A Quick Look
Meta Title: Slack and Superflow: A Quick Look
Description: Want to get Superflow updates in Slack?
Meta Description: Want to get Superflow updates in Slack? This setup lets you know about new comments, replies, and mentions right in your Slack channels.
overview: This setup lets you know about new comments, replies, and mentions right in your Slack channels.
steps__1__text:
• Go to your Superflow account.

  • Click on 'integrations' and pick 'Slack'.

  • Follow the steps to link Superflow with Slack.

  • Choose a Slack channel where you want updates.

  • Now, when someone comments in Superflow, you'll see it in Slack!
steps__2__text: • Once linked, you'll get alerts in Slack for comments and mentions in Superflow.
steps__3__text: • Want updates from a specific Superflow project in a Slack channel? Just pick the project and channel.
steps__4__text: Get messages only when someone mentions you or talks to you in a comment.

Title: Asana Integration with Superflow
Description: Turn your Superflow comments into Asana tasks or subtasks.
Meta Description: Turn your Superflow comments into Asana tasks or subtasks.
overview:
The integration of Asana with Superflow streamlines the process of converting Superflow comments into Asana tasks or subtasks.

This seamless integration ensures that Superflow aligns perfectly with your pre-existing workflow, allowing you to centralize website feedback and tasks within your current Asana projects.
steps__1__text:
• Navigate to the integrations page within the Superflow portal.

  • Choose the desired Asana Workspace. This will serve as the destination for exported Superflow comments.
steps__2__title: Associate a SuperFlow Project with an Asana Project:
steps__2__text:
• Subsequently, establish a connection between a specific Superflow project and an Asana project.

  • All comments from Superflow will be automatically transformed into tasks within the designated Asana project.
steps__3__title: Connect to a Specific Asana Task (Optional):
steps__3__text:
• For more granular control, you have the option to link your Superflow project to a particular task within an Asana project.

  • In this configuration, all Superflow comments will materialize as subtasks beneath the chosen Asana task.
